# Architecture decision records

<!-- Generated by `pnpm adr` from the ADR files and scripts/adr-index.mjs. Do not edit by hand. -->

Short records of decisions made while building, with the reason and what would make us revisit them. The PRD and the Phase 0 plan stay the source of requirements; these record how they were met.

## Adding an ADR

- Write `NNNN-short-title.md`. Start it with `# NNNN. Title`, a `**Status:**` line, and a one-line `**Summary:**` of the decision, like the ADRs below.
- Number an ADR when its PR merges, not in a plan or brief. Use the next free number on `main`; if another PR takes that number first, renumber on rebase (file name, title, and references to it).
- Run `pnpm adr` to rebuild this index. `pnpm adr:check` (in `pnpm verify` and CI) fails on a stale index or on two ADRs with the same number.
- This file merges with git's union driver (`.gitattributes`), so a rebase keeps rows from both sides; run `pnpm adr` afterwards.
- When a later change refines a decision, amend its ADR in place with a dated "Update" section.

| ADR | Title | Decision | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [0001](0001-workspace-and-dependencies.md) | Workspace, tooling, and dependency policy | pnpm workspace, TypeScript 7, Biome, Vitest; exact pins with a 14-day cooldown | Accepted |
| [0002](0002-data-access.md) | Data access: plain SQL, tenant context per transaction | Plain SQL over `pg`, no query builder; tenant context per transaction; row-level security | Accepted |
| [0003](0003-ids-and-decimals.md) | IDs and exact decimals | UUIDv7 IDs; quantities and money as `numeric(20,6)` and decimal strings | Accepted |
| [0004](0004-audit-pipeline.md) | Audit pipeline | Queue for attempts, reads, and failures; success events in the business transaction; monthly partitions | Accepted |
| [0005](0005-operation-registry.md) | Operation registry, REST, OpenAPI, and MCP | One registry generates REST, OpenAPI, permissions, audit names, and task-shaped MCP tools | Accepted |
| [0006](0006-inventory-concurrency.md) | Inventory concurrency and expiry | Position locks in id order, a database check on allocations, lazy expiry | Accepted |
| [0007](0007-mcp-connection-binding.md) | MCP authorization and shop binding with WorkOS standalone Connect | MCP shop binding through WorkOS standalone Connect: Airstock consent creates the grant, the first token binds its client | Accepted |
| [0008](0008-shopify-sync.md) | Shopify sync: orders to reservations, compare-and-set availability push | Shopify: expiring encrypted tokens, receipts with jobs, orders reserved by the connector, compare-and-set push that processes unseen orders before calling a conflict | Accepted |
| [0009](0009-transactional-email.md) | Transactional email: Resend for now | Resend for invitations, links without secrets, idempotent sends; account data in the US until revisited | Accepted for Phase 0 and the pilot |
| [0010](0010-web-app.md) | Dashboard web app | React, Vite, and TanStack app at `/app`, built into the Worker's static assets under the same CSP | Accepted |
| [0011](0011-rate-limits-and-client-events.md) | Rate limits and client-reported events | Workers Rate Limiting per user, credential, and connection with per-minute refusal summaries; client events batched into one queue message | Accepted |
| [0012](0012-custom-fields.md) | Custom fields, families, options, and rich text | Typed JSONB attributes keyed by field ID, one shared encoder, inheritance by key presence, stable option IDs; Markdown rich text | Accepted |
| [0013](0013-edit-concurrency.md) | Field-level compare-and-set for catalog edits | Field-level compare-and-set on the value the caller read; conflicts name who changed the field | Accepted |
| [0014](0014-catalog-query.md) | Catalog query compiler | Typed filter compiler with keyset paging, two row modes, full-text and trigram search, one duplicate check, saved views | Accepted |
| [0015](0015-media.md) | Media: uploads through the Worker, browser-made derivatives, signed delivery | Media uploads stream through the Worker to R2 with checks; the browser makes derivatives; signed links; one access event per request | Accepted |
| [0016](0016-warehouse-records.md) | Warehouse records and the location hierarchy | Warehouse records with contract terms visible only with `storage.commercial.read`; location paths, cascading archive and exact restore, eligibility that applies downwards | Accepted |
| [0017](0017-grid-and-bulk-edits.md) | Product grid and bulk edits | Variants and products rows over one query, virtualized grid with compare-and-set cells; bulk edits previewed, then committed all or nothing | Accepted |
| [0018](0018-imports-and-exports.md) | CSV imports and exports | CSV in R2; preview stores validated rows; set-based chunks of 200 with checkpoints, opening-stock receipts in the same transaction; exports from the catalog query | Accepted |
| [0019](0019-packaging-labels-bundles.md) | Packs, barcodes, labels, bundles, and suppliers | Packs resolve exactly to base units with versions; barcodes unique per shop on the normalized code; labels resolved on the server and drawn in the browser; bundle availability computed on read; supplier costs behind `costs.read` | Accepted |
| [0020](0020-stock-model.md) | Stock model: positions, conditions, lots, serials, reservations, and allocation | Positions per variant, location, condition, lot, serial, and transfer; one in-transit system location per shop; one shared SQL function for what is sellable now; explicit allocations chosen by a per-channel rule, earliest expiry then oldest stock first | Accepted |
| [0021](0021-shortages.md) | Shortages: only connectors, filled oldest first by receipts | Only connector callers reserve with a shortage; receipts fill open shortages oldest first in their own transaction (a shop setting), a 30-minute sweep catches the rest; availability never goes below zero | Accepted |
| [0022](0022-valuation.md) | Valuation: moving average per variant, history rows for any date | One moving average per variant per shop over owned stock, kept with the owned quantity in a locked `variant_costs` row; every entry stores the unit cost it applied; one history row per change makes value at any past moment and cost of goods reproducible; half-even rounding at 6 places | Accepted |
| [0023](0023-outgoing-webhooks.md) | Outgoing webhooks | Event types from a registry in code; per-shop subscriptions with encrypted, rotatable secrets; events written to the outbox with the change and fanned out per subscription at dispatch; signed POSTs with retries through the jobs queue; REST only | Accepted |
| [0024](0024-one-of-a-kind-items.md) | One-of-a-kind items, both ways | A one-of-a-kind variant holds at most one unit, checked under the variant's cost-row lock, becomes "sold" after fulfillment and active again when it returns; units that share a price are serials on one variant; a quick add creates and receives an item in one command; two starter families for cards and sets | Accepted |
| [0025](0025-scanning-and-installed-app.md) | Scanning and the installed app | The scanner lives in the React app at `/app/scan` under the app's CSP plus `'wasm-unsafe-eval'`; BarcodeDetector where it reads the needed formats, the vendored zxing-wasm elsewhere (iOS); keyboard wedges in every scan field; flows are plug-ins; the service worker caches the app shell only | Accepted |
| [0026](0026-picking.md) | Picking: pick lists from allocations, picks that never move stock | A pick list is one line per outstanding allocation of open reservations, walked in location-path order; picks record quantities and never change stock; another lot or position reallocates through the reservation's own command; a short pick flags the line and names the position to count; completing fulfills manual and API reservations and only records Shopify orders' picks | Accepted |
| [0027](0027-purchase-orders.md) | Purchase orders | Orders with authoritative per-line ordered, received, and cancelled quantities in base units; receipts against a line run the normal receipt path at the line's cost; on order counts open lines of sent orders; the PDF is drawn in the Worker with the label fonts and emailed through Resend with a send log | Accepted |
| [0025](0025-transfers.md) | Transfers: holds as typed reservations, transit positions per transfer, the transfer row locked first | A ready transfer holds stock with one reservation of purpose `transfer` per line; dispatch consumes it into in-transit positions that name the transfer; per-line quantities are authoritative and the status is derived from them; transfer commands lock their transfer row first, then follow ADR 0006 | Accepted |
